//: Copy this file to data/<your-slug>.json (e.g. data/google.json) to create a tailored resume at /<your-slug>. All placeholder values must be replaced with real data before the page will render correctly. In production, set the env var RESUME_DATA_<SLUG> (e.g. RESUME_DATA_GOOGLE) to the full JSON string instead of committing the file.

basics.//: Displayed in the hero section and page header. 'label' is your job title. 'summary' is a short paragraph shown in the Summary section — tailor it for the target company/role.
basics.name: Your Name
basics.label: Your Job Title
basics.summary: A short professional summary tailored for this specific resume version.

location.//: 'countryCode' follows ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. SG, US, GB).

profiles.//: Add as many social/professional profiles as needed. 'network' is the display name.

work.//: List roles in reverse-chronological order (most recent first). Use 'highlights' for bullet points. Leave 'endDate' as 'Present' for your current role.
work.name: Company Name
work.summary: Brief description of your role and team context.
highlights: Key achievement or responsibility — quantify impact where possible.

education.//: 'studyType' is the degree name (e.g. Bachelor of Science). 'score' can hold a GPA or grade — leave empty to hide it.

skills.//: 'level' is a free-text descriptor shown as a badge (e.g. Expert, Proficient, Familiar). 'keywords' are individual skill tags within the category.
skills.name: Skill Category

projects.//: 'description' is a short one-liner shown as a subtitle. 'highlights' are the bullet points. Leave 'url' empty to hide the link.
projects.name: Project Name
projects.description: Brief project description shown as a subtitle.

certificates.//: 'date' is the issue date. 'url' links to the credential — leave empty to hide.
certificates.name: Certification Name

languages.//: 'fluency' is a free-text level descriptor (e.g. Native, Professional Proficiency, Conversational). 'description' is optional context shown beneath the fluency label.
